name: Gadgets
title: Techline Gadgets: how a phone shop runs on Taskiem
blurb: One week at Techline Gadgets in Computer Village, Ikeja, Lagos: a phone in every storage and colour, a counter sale, a WhatsApp order, a rider for same-day delivery, a restock from a distributor in Kano, a price for a reseller in Ibadan, and the morning's numbers, all run alongside the chats Ikenna already has with his customers and suppliers. Episode 0 shows the whole week; Episodes 1 to 10 teach each part.
card_sub: A week at Techline Gadgets: stock, orders, riders and dealers.
cta_sub: Taskiem works alongside your chats: orders, stock, money and staff, taken care of.
